items.answerHr: Tržišna stranica prikazuje informativne podatke o Bitcoinu, digitalnoj imovini, zlatu, Brent nafti i valutnim odnosima uz jasnu oznaku statusa svakog podatka.
items.answerEn: The market page presents informational data on Bitcoin, digital assets, gold, Brent crude and currency relations with a clear status label for each item.
